name: UNDERTALE
info: UNDERTALE! The RPG game where you don't have to destroy anyone.

name: UNDERTALE [ESP]
info:
UNDERTALE! El juego RPG donde no tienes que matar a cualquiera.
Si no aparece en español la primera vez cambialo en la configuracion

name: DELTARUNE
info: Dive into the parallel story to UNDERTALE! Fight or spare your way through action-packed battles as you explore a mysterious world alongside an endearing cast of new and familiar characters. Chapters 1-5 are available now, with more planned as free updates!

name: DELTARUNE [ESP]
info: Dive into the parallel story to UNDERTALE! Fight or spare your way through action-packed battles as you explore a mysterious world alongside an endearing cast of new and familiar characters. Chapters 1-5 are available now, with more planned as free updates!

name: UNDERTALE Bits & Pieces [ESP]
info: Undertale: Bits and Pieces was an unofficial mod of Toby Fox's Undertale, made by Team BnP, that reimagined the game.

name: WorldBox
info: WorldBox is the ULTIMATE god simulator and sandbox game. A petri dish for your fantasy civilizations. Create your own world or destroy it using many powers.

name: Balatro
info: The poker roguelike. Balatro is a hypnotically satisfying deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos.

name: Geometry Dash
info: Jump and fly your way through danger in this rhythm-based action platformer!

name: Geometry Dash + Geode
info:
Jump and fly your way through danger in this rhythm-based action platformer!
Geode is a fan-made extension for Geometry Dash that adds mod support to the game. Browse from an in-game list to seamlessly download mods.

name: Among Us
info: An online and local party game of teamwork and betrayal for 4-15 players...in space!

name: Super Mario 64 Coop DX
info: sm64coopdx is an online multiplayer project for the Super Mario 64 PC port that supports widescreen, uncapped FPS, and has many toggleable options for customization to fit your desired experience. It has multiplayer up to 16 players and an ever growing powerful Lua modding API that allow modders and players to enjoy Super Mario 64 in more accessible and unique new ways!

name: Hollow Knight
info: Forge your own path in Hollow Knight! An epic action adventure through a vast ruined kingdom of insects and heroes. Explore twisting caverns, battle tainted creatures and befriend bizarre bugs, all in a classic, hand-drawn 2D style.

name: Cuphead
info: Cuphead is a classic run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Inspired by cartoons of the 1930s, the visuals and audio are painstakingly created with the same techniques of the era, i.e. traditional hand drawn cel animation, watercolor backgrounds, and original jazz recordings.

name: Five Nights at Freddy’s
info: Five Nights at Freddy’s 1 (FNAF 1) is a very unusual horror quest in which players are invited to plunge into an eerie atmosphere in which Light is associated with life, and Darkness with death Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza.

name: Five Nights at Freddy’s 2
info: Welcome back to the new and improved Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza In Five Nights at Freddy’s 2, the old and aging animatronics are joined by a new cast of characters.

name: Five Nights at Freddy’s 3
info: Thirty years after Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza closed it’s doors, the events that took place there have become nothing more than a rumor and a childhood memory, but the owners of 'Fazbear’s Fright: The Horror Attraction' are determined to revive the legend and make the experience as authentic as possible for patrons.

name: Five Nights at Freddy’s 4
info: This time, the terror has followed you home. In this last chapter of the Five Nights at Freddy’s original story, you must once again defend yourself against Freddy Fazbear, Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, and even worse things that lurk in the shadows.
